Article: Polish woman looses child in sham-marriage with Nigerian man seeking residence permit

Edit: TL;DR

  • Nigerian man wanting residence in Denmark goes to Poland and finds a single mom

  • Offers her 2500 euros for a sham-marriage

  • They get married in Denmark, she also legally makes the Nigerian man her child's father

  • She never gets paid, the money he owes here

  • She seeks divorce, causing the Nigerian man to loose his residency in Denmark

  • The Nigerian man legally takes her child in order to remain in Denmark

English: (google-trans)

An attempt to earn easy money has ended up as a nightmare for a young mother from the Polish city of Lodz. Ewa Zuchowska has been stranded in Denmark for two years without legal residence and lives homeless. But she will not go home without her son, as she has lost him to her pro-forma man from Nigeria.

The Nigerian man now has full custody of the 4-year-old Polish boy, and Ewa has not seen her son for long periods. - I'm still in Denmark, because I can not leave my son. I made a huge mistake, but it should not be my son, who will pay for it, says Ewa Zuchowska.

Said yes to marriage for money And Ewa Zuchowska has committed serious errors and also illegal activities. In 2011, she was sought out in Poland by a Nigerian man who offered the single mother 2,500 euros to travel with him to Denmark and get him a residence permit. Ewa Zuchowska accepted the agreement, and on June 10, 2011, she got married at Frederiksberg City Hall. - The wedding ceremony was a great comedy. I had a mans ring on which was so large that it fell off, and I was wearing a swimsuit, as if I was going to the beach. We did not look like a family, that's for sure, says Ewa Zuchowska.

Gets proforma cleaning job Before a marriage to an EU citizen, like Ewa Zuchowska, could grant residency to her Nigerian pro-man, it requires that she can can prove an income to the State Administration, so she can provide for him. So after the ceremony, Ewa Zuchowska signed an employment contract with a cleaning company, which would be used to demonstrate to the State Administration that she could support her husband and then qualify for family reunification under EU rules for migrant workers.

But she never even worked - instead her pro-husband did. - After the ceremony, I signed a contract with a cleaning company, but it was he who did the work, she says.

The fraud succeed Ewa Zuchowskas pro-husband took her to a Danish Bank and asked her to open an account. But she never got the papers. They were sent along with the debit card to his address, said Ewa Zuchowska. With the marriage certificate, bank account and employment contract records Ewa Zuchowska and her pro-man are registered with the state administration. It is the authority handling the residence of EU citizens and their spouses. The fraudulent number works, and the couple obtains residence in Denmark via Ewa Zuchowskas status as a migrant worker in the EU with documented income from the cleaning job.

Broken promises of payment But the Nigerian man does not pay Ewa Zuchowska the promised 2,500 euros, and she seeks divorce in Denmark in 2013. In the divorce her Nigerian pro-forma husband looses his Danish residence permit. According to Ewa Zuchowska the man takes her then 2-year-old son Victor from her. P1 Documentary spoke with several sources confirming the story. Ewa Zuchowska turned to the police several times and admitted her role in the fraud, but police would not investigate her sham marriage. As Ewa among many documents have signed a document that makes her pro-man legal father of her son, it looks like an impossible battle.

From the Comment Section:

The guy sent a letter to the council proving she did not have a regular job, but was in-fact working in prostitution - something he got her into. He wrote that he was worried about 'his kid' on those grounds - he gained full custody on those grounds.

This is not written in the article, but is mentioned in the radio-documentary.
